posts.title: how i taught an entire high school to read a clock, instantly
posts.description: Since the state issued a school cell phone ban, many of my students have started asking me what time it is. We have analog clocks in every classroom, synched to the bell system. When I tell them we have a clock and it works, they said, "I can't read that kind of clock." Dozens of them have told me this since the year started. Certainly dozens more than last year. posts.title: the post that should have come before the cleaning post: organizing
posts.description: A couple weeks ago, I wrote about how I clean my house: how i clean my house In that post, I noted that Step One is "put everything back where it goes." I also noted that this can be hard to do when some things do not have a designated Place Where They Go. Here's how to make sure everything in your house has a Place Where It Goes.
